evidence.summary: The Air Force Research Institute (空军研究院) is the PLA Air Force’s research academy: the service formed it in 2004 as the Air Force Equipment Research Academy, consolidating more than 20 of its research organisations around Beijing to speed up the informatisation of its equipment and weapons, and renamed it in July 2017. Its institutes include air defence and anti-missile, aviation, strategic early warning and systems engineering research institutes.
The institute belongs to the PLA Air Force; PLA Air Force headquarters set up its predecessor in 2004.
